statement: The record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so it should be held rather than paid again.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the payment would be a duplicate — "already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so it should be held rather than paid again" — contradicting the record's "unpaid, due" status.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
